column1: # memfn/data/cards/kit-grid.tsv — THE KIT'S METHOD CARDS, `kit-grid@N` (R-MS5;
# docs/design/measure_sets.md §7.2; r17b_prime.md §5.2). One row per
# (owner, quantity, ver), APPEND-ONLY by version: a committed row never
# changes. `ver 1` is grid1's method (the run zen4-grid1, gridread @
# 540649453: docs/dev/lanes/grid1_report.md, gridread_report.md), the method
# every row of the interim set kit-interim-grid1 was measured under. `ver 2`
# (grid2's: the dispatch charges, the one-byte libc rows, NONE, the pre-scan
# gate, the mode branch, M16-M24) is grid2's prep lane's, NOT written here.
# `ver 3` is span_pick stage 2's (docs/design/memfn/span_cards.md §2.4, unit
# S2c): the four cards zen4-grid3 is measured under (find_byte, find_hit,
# verify_cmp, enter), each timed arm the form's canonical instance rendered
# by formhash.c's entry table (§3.2).
# Columns (measure_sets.md §7.2): owner quantity ver dims unit subject
# lengths launches rounds aa_rule gate_e6 env deps.
#   dims     the key's dimension names in order (§1.3): a key
#            `kit.<quantity>.<t1>...` has exactly this many tokens
#   unit     ratio (to the version's u, or a dimensionless ratio), walkbytes
#            (cost in u.B), bytes. u per version: ver 1 u = beta_walk(DFA_SCAN,
#            r1e0c0) = 0.1892 ns/B; ver 3 u = find_byte.walk (span_cards.md
#   lengths  ver 1: the lengths measured, in prose. ver 3: the row's
#            ESTIMATOR in the spec's grammar (measures.md §3.4), integers
#            only: `slope X1,X2,X3` (the per-byte slope over those call
#            lengths) or `delta LEN` (the arm minus its base arm at length
#            LEN, the base named on the row's own cells, never here)
#   aa_rule  the A/A design: ver 1 `pair-per-group`; ver 3 `twin-per-arm`
#            (every timed arm has its own A/A twin, an independent placement
#            in the same launch) and, on the unit's card, `bimodal-test`
#            (measure_sets.md §1.4), `;`-joined
#   gate_e6  the group's refusal gate: UNMEASURED DEFAULT (D149) until derived
#            from committed sets (§7.3); `-` where the row is derived. ver 3
#            states `-`: its gate is the kit policy table's gate_default_e6
#            (../policy.tsv, R-35 (e), review r9 SLOT-17), one home; the
#            producer writes the value it gated by on the card it publishes
#            in a set
#   env      the method's declared safe direction (`-` until M2, R-MS4)
#   deps     the dependency ids the producer hashes (§2.4): kit:form.<id>
#            (mf_form_hash; `walk`, `libc` render at B1, V1 at B4, S1/A1
#            (the W64 rows) at B6: tests/memfn/run_finder.sh lists the
#            unresolved as OWED, never as a pass). ver 3 lists its form ids
#            (formhash.c's entry table; `walk-set` folded into `walk`, its
#            site text being the walk's): a row records
#            `kit:form.<its form token>=<hash>` (span_cards.md §2.4). A card
#            naming a kit:form. dep has `form` as its FIRST dim
#            (finder_check.py check C)
# Divergence recorded (fdb1_report.md F-B1-6): r17b_prime.md §5.2's card table

# `kit.gstar.<liner>.<kind>` (two tokens). The card follows the READER; a
# shape split, if grid2 measures one, is a ver bump and a row edit.
